title: Tech View has its own column chooser and adds an Assigned Techs column
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A known set of columns chosen in List.
custom_steps:
1. Note the columns and open the column chooser in List.
  2. Switch to Tech View.
  3. Open the column chooser in Tech View.
  4. Compare the available columns and the chooser.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Tech View offers the same columns as List, plus an Assigned Techs column (Story 7).
  • It has its own column chooser (Story 5), separate from List.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10045 — Tech View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S2-R4 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
